answers: IT HAD NO ENTRY AT ALL and fell through to 99, so 34 unread pages — the second-largest block here — were sorting below `unknown`. The reason to rank it high is one line of `model/finance.py`: `excluded_debt=2_199_352.52`, a figure TYPED INTO THE MODEL, and debt-excluded borrowing is a real component of the levy the town raises.
